slides.headline: Run models like DeepSeek and Gemma
slides.say: Did you know you can now get up and running with models like DeepSeek and Gemma? This is Day 1 of our exclusive 100-day series, finding the best GitHub repo for you.

slides.headline: Runs many AI models
slides.body: Supports Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma
slides.say: This tool helps you get up and running with models like DeepSeek, Gemma, and others. You install it and begin chatting right away.

slides.headline: Works with many apps
slides.body: Connects to Claude Code, Copilot, Open WebUI, and more
slides.say: It connects with coding assistants like Claude Code and Copilot. It also works with chat interfaces like Open WebUI. Desktop and mobile apps exist too.

slides.headline: 182,134 GitHub stars
slides.body: MIT licence · Written in Go · Since June 2023
slides.say: It has over 180 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the MIT licence. It's written in Go and it's been around since June 2023.

slides.headline: Read the docs first
slides.body: Check the README and licence before you begin
slides.say: Before using this, read the README and the MIT licence. Many integrations are community projects, not official releases. Verify each integration works for you.

slides.headline: Save · Share · Follow
slides.body: Comment REPO for the full list
slides.say: Loved it? Save this, and send it to a friend. Follow for the next 99 repos... or you might not see us again. Comment REPO, and I'll send you the full list, with install commands and similar repos.
